findings.finding: Two web builds are identical in CI because vite.config.ts takes GITHUB_SHA before DISPATCH_BUILD, so the acceptance test would pass with no fix.
findings.answer: T1.5 changes the order to DISPATCH_BUILD ?? GITHUB_SHA ?? Date.now() (nothing sets DISPATCH_BUILD today; the image build sets neither), builds B into web/dist-b, and T2.1 fails the spec unless the entry chunks and asset lists differ.

findings.finding: The store protects a roll only when the outgoing build carries it; no rule guarantees that.
findings.answer: Plan section 'Sequencing' item 1 and sequencingForArchitect[0], sent to the INFRA-63 architect for root item 7's gate; states what an older-build tab sees during that first roll.

findings.finding: Storage growth not estimated; 14 days not tied to release rate; census 1 GiB table limit.
findings.answer: Measured 14 releases a day on average, 47 at most (git log). Retention changed to live builds plus the 20 most recently started (about 110 MB raw); prune tests in T3.8.
Publish holds pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared and prune the exclusive lock on one key; the build row and its links commit with the assets in one transaction; a concurrent publish/prune test in T3.8.

findings.finding: A new leased loop has no lease-pool connection (leasePoolSize 8, zero headroom).
findings.answer: No loop is added: prune runs at boot, the only moment the newest-20 set changes (decision 8).

findings.finding: A store read can still fail an asset during a roll (8 MiB reservation, 64 MiB cap, 3 s bound).
findings.answer: T3.4 adds a 64 MiB process-wide cache of store reads with singleflight for concurrent misses; hits need no reservation; reads use the shared pool; a 200-request burst test through the real store in T3.8.

findings.finding: Both builds share the tab's sessionStorage key and the inline script duplicates the rule.
findings.answer: New key dispatch.chunk-reloads (JSON times); the old key is neither read nor written, so the builds never misread each other; each copy names the other; an e2e row where the inline script and a lazy chunk share the budget (T4.4).

findings.finding: Registry undefined: build identity, 404 from old pods, clock, test speed, ownership.
findings.answer: Identity = sha256(index.html)[:16] hex mapped to the entry chunk; 404/401/5xx/network = no banner with unit tests; database clock; Go test ages a row in the database instead of waiting; registry owned by INFRA-555 (agreed over Envoy).

findings.finding: Existing tests, docs and the delivery-live probe hard-code reconnect at once; whole-cache refresh spread risks staleness.
findings.answer: T6.4 rewrites the named tests and the probe; T7 the docs; the refresh is not delayed further, only the reconnect is spread over [0, 2 s), mean equal to today's 1 s; distribution test with a 10 % per-100 ms bound.
